description: Métro du réseau STAR : emprises des stations is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Localisation des emprises des stations du métro du réseau de transport en commun de l'agglomération rennaise. Ces polygones permettent de connaître de façon approximative les emprises des stations du métro dans le milieu urbain. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are métro, métro, bâtiment. The portal shows 30 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2012-07-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
